$$\Rightarrow brother:mother=(7\times8):(8\times8)$$

$$\Rightarrow mother:sister=(8\times8):(1\times8)$$

$$\Rightarrow 56:64:8$$

$$\Rightarrow 56:64:8=7:8:1$$

$$\Rightarrow 7:8:1$$

Therefore, brother:mother:sister is

$$\Rightarrow 7 : 8 : 1$$
